final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client GROUP BY district_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total FROM district_counts WHERE client_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT dc.district_id, dc.client_count, CAST(dc.client_count AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
